plurals.name: g_speech_after_stop_help
plurals.item: After Stop, this model transcribes the recording again from its audio, and the notes are written from that transcript. Only for recordings in a language the model knows. Skip stops that. A recording whose audio isn\'t kept, or one that would take the model more than about %1$d minute, keeps the transcript made while recording; Transcribe again works on any length.
